subject: Novagrid + Caravel — integration validation kick-off & test runbook
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hsu <tom@novagrid.io>, Anna Morales <anna@caravelconsulting.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Novagrid + Caravel — integration validation kick-off & test runbook

Hi Tom / Anna —

Thanks again for the productive sync last week. I want to kick off a short technical validation to make sure the reference design and test coverage align before we scope a joint customer demo. Proposed objectives: 
- Validate auth and network flows for the Novagrid connector to Redwood Private runtime
- Run the Caravel test matrix for throughput and failover scenarios (cold-start, model fallback)
- Smoke the prefix/KV cache behavior with representative sequences

Requested deliverables from NovaGrid / Caravel by Friday (30 Jul):
1) Reference architecture diagram (network zones, NAT, KMS/HSM integration, expected traffic patterns)
2) Sandbox credentials (read-only tokens or ephemeral creds) + sandbox endpoint
3) Initial test matrix (CSV/Excel) with pass/fail criteria

We propose the validation window: Aug 2–6 (engineers available). Can you confirm availability and share the artifacts? Once we have those I'll circulate a concise runbook and assign who owns each test.

Attachments: none in this message.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Senior Partnerships Engineer
Redwood Inference

Thanks — confirmed on our side. We attached a concise architecture overview and the initial test matrix for Novagrid connector validation. High level notes:
- NovaGrid will expose a test endpoint in the us-west-2 region (non-prod) and provide ephemeral API keys.
- Caravel will run the throughput and failure injection scenarios; we recommend starting with the 1k-token sequence and a 2k-token stress run.
- Potential risk: KMS handshake currently uses an older cipher suite that may require a compatibility shim — we flagged that in the diagram.

Attachments:
- novagrid-arch-overview.pdf (diagram + network callouts)
- caravel-test-matrix.xlsx (initial tests and acceptance criteria)
- novagrid-sandbox-creds-stub.txt (placeholder; full creds will be handled through vault)

We are available Aug 3–5 for active testing (primary engineers: Anna Morales, Tom Hsu). Please share the Redwood runbook and any tooling we should instrument (tracing hooks, metric names).

Best,
Anna Morales
Principal Solutions Architect
Caravel Consulting

Subject: Re: Fwd: Novagrid + Caravel — integration validation kick-off & test runbook

Great — reviewed the arch PDF. Top-level findings (quick):
1) KMS cipher: this is the main compatibility risk. Short-term mitigation: negotiate a TLS cipher fallback for the handshake on the sandbox (we can enable the shim in the Private control plane for the validation window).
2) Egress NAT: Novagrid uses a small NAT pool in the test environment. Need to ensure per-connection ephemeral sockets are permitted for sustained throughput tests (1k+ concurrent connections).
3) Tracing: ask Caravel to include x-request-id and x-trace-id on requests; we'll capture with our agent and map token-level timing.

I attached a first-pass runbook draft that lists test steps, metric names, and data collection paths. Lauren — please add ownership for each test and the timings (I left placeholders).

Attachments: redwood-runbook-draft.md

Sergio Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
